stepBody: Now, you are interested in estimating the average amount of plays their songs have online. You generate a separate 80% confidence interval for this new parameter to be [700000, 1200000] based on a random sample of $$50$$ songs. Is the following statement true or false?\n\nNote: Generally, $$n$$ $$ \geq $$ $$30$$ is considered the minimum sample size for CLT to take effect!
